nodes.description: Public state variable holding the governance (owner) address, set to msg.sender in the constructor.
Public mapping of addresses allowed to mint; declared but never modified or enforced in this contract.
Private total token supply, mutated by _mint and _burn.
Private mapping of account balances, mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Private nested mapping of owner/spender allowances, mutated by _approve.
Deployer of CurveI: assigns governance = msg.sender and mints 10000e18 tokens to governance.
Public ERC20 transfer that forwards to _transfer using _msgSender() as sender.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that moves tokens and decrements the caller allowance.
Public approval function delegating to _approve.
Increases spender allowance using SafeMath.add then _approve.
Decreases spender allowance using SafeMath.sub then _approve.
Internal transfer: checks zero addresses and moves balances with SafeMath.
Internal mint: increases _totalSupply and recipient balance with SafeMath.add.
Internal burn: decreases account balance and _totalSupply with SafeMath.sub.
Internal approval writer: validates addresses and writes _allowances.
Helper returning msg.sender as address payable; the entry point of caller-controlled data.
Encodes token.transfer and routes it through callOptionalReturn.
Encodes token.transferFrom and routes it through callOptionalReturn.
Encodes token.approve and routes it through callOptionalReturn after an allowance guard.
Verifies the target is a contract and performs an arbitrary low-level call with user-influenced calldata.
Returns whether an account has code, using inline assembly extcodehash.
Checked unsigned addition reverting on overflow.
Checked unsigned subtraction reverting on underflow.
Checked unsigned multiplication reverting on overflow.
Checked unsigned division reverting on division by zero.
Caller-controlled address used for governance assignment and all transfer/approve authorizations.
address(token).call(data) inside callOptionalReturn: arbitrary external call to an attacker-suppliable token address, executed without a reentrancy guard.
Inline assembly reading extcodehash(account) inside Address.isContract.
Recipient address parameter of ERC20.transfer.
Amount parameter of ERC20.transfer.
Amount parameter of ERC20._transfer consumed by the balance subtractions.
Value parameter of SafeERC20.safeTransfer encoded into the outgoing call.
Arbitrary calldata parameter passed to the low-level call in callOptionalReturn.

edges.reason: _msgSender() directly returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
Constructor assigns privileged governance state from the caller-derived msg.sender.
Deployer address becomes the sole governance authority, granting mint/owner privileges.
Constructor writes msg.sender into the governance state variable.
Constructor invokes _mint to create the initial 10000e18 supply.
Caller-controlled address is stored as governance, an unprotected ownership assignment pattern.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_mint credits the recipient balance in _balances.
_mint relies on SafeMath.add for supply and balance increments.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender of the funds.
transfer delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom reduces the allowance via _approve.
transferFrom subtracts the transferred amount from the allowance using SafeMath.sub.
approve delegates allowance writing to _approve.
increaseAllowance writes the new allowance through _approve.
increaseAllowance adds to the allowance using SafeMath.add.
decreaseAllowance writes the new allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance subtracts from the allowance using SafeMath.sub.
_transfer debits the sender and credits the recipient in _balances.
_transfer uses SafeMath.sub on the sender balance.
_transfer uses SafeMath.add on the recipient balance.
_burn debits the account balance in _balances.
_burn reduces _totalSupply.
_burn uses SafeMath.sub for the burn arithmetic.
_approve writes the owner/spender allowance into _allowances.
safeTransfer forwards the encoded transfer call to callOptionalReturn.
safeTransferFrom forwards the encoded transferFrom call to callOptionalReturn.
safeApprove forwards the encoded approve call to callOptionalReturn.
callOptionalReturn performs an external low-level call to an arbitrary token address with no reentrancy protection, allowing the callee to re-enter transfer/transferFrom.
callOptionalReturn requires address(token).isContract() before calling.
isContract executes the extcodehash inline assembly.
Attacker-influenced calldata is passed straight into the low-level call, enabling arbitrary external execution and reentrancy.
transfer recipient parameter flows into _transfer.
transfer amount parameter flows into _transfer.
_transfer amount parameter is consumed by SafeMath.sub on the sender balance.
safeTransfer value parameter is encoded into the calldata forwarded to callOptionalReturn.

normalization_plan.reason: ERC20.transfer.recipient is a parameter that only exists to feed the recipient slot of ERC20._transfer; it has no independent semantic role.
ERC20.transfer.amount is a parameter that only exists to feed the amount slot of ERC20._transfer.
ERC20._transfer.amount is a parameter whose only downstream use is the SafeMath.sub balance arithmetic, so it collapses into that core arithmetic operation.
SafeERC20.safeTransfer.value is a parameter that is only encoded and forwarded by the core function safeTransfer.
SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn.data is a parameter that is passed unchanged into the unsafe low-level call, so it merges into its enclosing core function.
